notablePrerequisites:
6 other creatures under your control on the battlefield.
7+ life.
4+ players in the game.
description:
Cast Leshrac's Sigil for 4 life.
When you cast Leshrac's Sigil, extort triggers for each creature go on the stack.
Pay 2 life for each netting you 1 life each time.
Return Leshrac's Sigil to your hand using its ability and paying 4 life.
Repeat.
